evidence.quote: In particular, I will focus on how banks manage liquidity risk, the role of the central bank's discount window lending in this process, and the importance of robust liquidity planning for good times and bad.
The primary credit rate, set at the top of the target range, is a component for how we can achieve rate control under a range of conditions.
Banks need to be ready and willing to use the discount window in good times and bad.
